name: Q11
input: I have crates of RPGs in a Seaport stockpile. How do I uncrate them?
expected_output: You cannot uncrate items directly at a Seaport or Storage Depot. Seaports and Storage Depots are wholesale logistics facilities that only store and dispense crated goods, and do not offer an option to uncrate items directly from their stockpile. To uncrate the RPGs, retrieve the crates into your inventory or a vehicle, transport and submit them to a Base stockpile (Town Hall, Relic Base, or Bunker Base). Once submitted to a Base, items can be retrieved individually.
context: Facility: Seaport / Storage Depot
Rule: Seaports and Storage Depots do not allow uncrating or unpacking items from stockpiles; there is no 'Retrieve as Item' menu action.
Unpack procedure: Crates must be submitted to a Base (Town Hall, Relic Base, Bunker Base) stockpile to be converted into individual items.

additional_metadata.source: Live sortie field report / agent hallucination incident
additional_metadata.failure_mode: Hallucination of non-existent UI context menu ('Retrieve as Item' at Seaport)
additional_metadata.note: Disallowing Seaport uncrating is a core Foxhole logistics constraint. Agent erroneously conflated Base stockpile item retrieval with Seaport crate operations.

name: Q12
input: If I am boating from The Scrying Belt (Nevish Line) through Callum's Cape towards Stem (Speaking Woods), is Tine a good halfway stopping point?
expected_output: No. Tine is located further east in Speaking Woods than Stem. When navigating from Nevish Line through Callum's Cape into Speaking Woods, the river corridor curves and enters Speaking Woods from the south, reaching Stem first. Tine (and its seaport) lies deeper into Speaking Woods to the east/northeast, past Stem. Therefore, Tine is not an intermediate stop on the way to Stem—it is further downriver.
context: World Conquest Map: Nevish Line (West), Callum's Cape (Middle), Speaking Woods (East).
Speaking Woods Hex Layout: River waterway enters Speaking Woods from the south, reaching Stem first; Tine is located further east/northeast.
Route sequence from West: The Scrying Belt -> Callum's Cape (Callum's Keep) -> Stem -> Tine.

additional_metadata.source: Live sortie navigation feedback / spatial hallucination incident
additional_metadata.failure_mode: Inverted spatial sequence / waypoint hallucination (suggested destination past target as intermediate stop)
additional_metadata.note: Agent failed to account for intra-hex relative positioning along the Callum's Cape -> Speaking Woods river corridor, placing Tine before Stem instead of past it.
